description.zh: 内网访问应用地址集合。最多可输入1000个内网访问应用地址。
description.en: The addresses of the internal-facing access application. You can specify up to 1000 addresses.

description.zh:
内网访问应用ID。取值来源：
- [ListPrivateAccessApplications](~~ListPrivateAccessApplications~~)：批量查询内网访问应用。
- [CreatePrivateAccessApplication](~~CreatePrivateAccessApplication~~)：创建内网访问应用。
description.en:
The ID of the internal-facing access application. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
- [ListPrivateAccessApplications](~~ListPrivateAccessApplications~~): lists internal-facing access applications.
- [CreatePrivateAccessApplication](~~CreatePrivateAccessApplication~~): creates an internal-facing access application.

description.zh: 内网访问应用描述。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格。
description.en: The description of the internal-facing access application. The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces.

description.zh: 浏览器访问模式参数：7层应用配置。
description.en: The browser access mode parameter: the Layer 7 application configuration.

description.zh: 浏览器访问模式参数：映射代理域名前缀。长度为3-20个字符，支持小写英文字母、数字和短划线（-）。
description.en: The browser access mode parameter: the prefix of the mapped proxy domain name. The prefix must be 3 to 20 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

description.zh: 浏览器访问模式参数：自定代理域名。
description.en: The browser access mode parameter: the custom proxy domain name.

description.zh: 浏览器访问模式参数：私有代理域名。
description.en: The browser access mode parameter: the private proxy domain name.

description.zh:
内网访问应用的修改类型。取值：
- **Cover**（默认）：使用**Addresses**、**PortRanges**、**TagIds**参数的值覆盖原地址、端口范围、标签ID集合。
- **Append**：在原地址、端口范围、标签ID集合中分别增加**Addresses**、**PortRanges**、**TagIds**参数中输入的值。
description.en:
The modification type of the internal-facing access application. Valid values:
- **Cover** (default): overwrites the original addresses, port ranges, and tag IDs with the values of the **Addresses**, **PortRanges**, and **TagIds** parameters.
- **Append**: adds the values of the **Addresses**, **PortRanges**, and **TagIds** parameters to the original addresses, port ranges, and tag IDs.

description.zh: 内网访问应用端口范围集合。最多可输入65535个端口范围。多个端口范围不可重复或重叠。
description.en: The port ranges of the internal-facing access application. You can specify up to 65535 port ranges. Multiple port ranges cannot be duplicate or overlap.

description.zh:
内网访问应用协议。取值：
- **All**：全部。
- **TCP**
- **UDP**
description.en:
The protocol of the internal-facing access application. Valid values:
- **All**: all protocols.
- **TCP**
- **UDP**

description.zh:
内网访问应用状态。取值：
- **Enabled**：开启。
- **Disabled**：关闭。
description.en:
The status of the internal-facing access application. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: enabled.
- **Disabled**: disabled.

description.zh: 内网访问标签ID集合。1个内网访问应用最多可关联6个自定义类型的内网访问标签。
description.en: The IDs of internal-facing access tags. You can associate up to 6 custom internal-facing access tags with each internal-facing access application.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun csas update-private-access-application --application-id pa-application-e12860ef6c480000 --description '这是一条内网访问应用' --addresses 192.168.0.0/16 --port-ranges Begin=80 End=81 --protocol All --status Enabled --tag-ids tag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000 --modify-type Cover --l7-proxy-domain-automatic-prefix app1-xxx --l7-proxy-domain-custom app1.example.com --l7-proxy-domain-private app1.example.com --l7-config example-string --config-mode example-string --address-groups '["example-string"]' --name example-string --unauthorized-access-config example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun csas UpdatePrivateAccessApplication --region cn-hangzhou --Status Enabled --PortRanges.1.Begin 80 --Description '这是一条内网访问应用' --UnauthorizedAccessConfig 'example-string' --AddressGroups.1 'example-string' --PortRanges.1.End 81 --Name 'example-string' --ModifyType Cover --TagIds.1 'tag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000' --L7ProxyDomainCustom 'app1.example.com' --L7ProxyDomainPrivate 'app1.example.com' --L7Config 'example-string' --L7ProxyDomainAutomaticPrefix 'app1-xxx' --ConfigMode 'example-string' --Addresses.1 '192.168.0.0/16' --ApplicationId 'pa-application-e12860ef6c480000' --Protocol All --method POST --force
